q: Akta Kerja 1955 dikuatkuasakan oleh:
c: Jabatan Tenaga Kerja Semenanjung Malaysia
e: Introduction: an Act enforced by Department of Labour Peninsular Malaysia; applies to private sector; provides minimum rights and benefits.

q: Pekerja yang dikecualikan daripada Akta Kerja 1955 termasuk mereka yang digaji terus oleh:
c: Badan berkanun dan pihak berkuasa tempatan
e: Employee covered: local/foreign, full/part-time, permanent/temporary, contract, probation. EXCLUDE: employees directly engaged by statutory body, local authorities (Exclusion Order).

q: Pekerja dalam tempoh percubaan (probation) di bawah Akta Kerja:
c: Diliputi oleh Akta
e: Employee covered by the Act: … confirm or under probation.

q: Menurut Akta Kerja, 'kontrak perkhidmatan' boleh dibuat:
c: Secara lisan atau bertulis, nyata atau tersirat
e: Contract of service: any agreement, whether oral or in writing and whether express or implied.

q: Kontrak perkhidmatan TIDAK boleh mengandungi terma yang:
c: Menyekat hak pekerja untuk menyertai kesatuan sekerja
e: Content of contract: must stipulate terms per Employment Regulations 1957 including termination; not to restrict rights to join, participate in or organize trade unions.

q: Potongan gaji yang memerlukan permintaan pekerja DAN permit termasuk:
c: Bayaran kepada pihak ketiga bagi pihak pekerja
w: Lebihan bayaran akibat kesilapan majikan dalam 3 bulan lepas
Potongan yang dibenarkan oleh undang-undang bertulis lain
Pendahuluan tanpa faedah di bawah seksyen 22
e: Sec. 24(3): at request of employee and with permit – schemes for benefit of employee, advance with interest, payments to third party, goods of employer, rental of accommodation.

q: Cara pembayaran gaji yang utama di bawah Seksyen 25 ialah:
c: Melalui institusi kewangan ke akaun atas nama pekerja
e: Sec. 25: paid into an account in the name of the employee; tunai atau cek hanya dengan permintaan bertulis pekerja dan kelulusan KP Tenaga Kerja.

q: Jika kerja perlu dijalankan secara berterusan, pekerja boleh bekerja 8 jam berturut-turut dengan rehat sekurang-kurangnya:
c: 45 minit secara agregat
e: Sec. 60A(1) exception: continuous work – 8 consecutive hours with at least 45 minutes break in aggregate.

q: Pekerja boleh dikehendaki bekerja melebihi had dan pada hari rehat (Seksyen 60A(2)) dalam kes:
c: Kerja segera pada jentera atau gangguan kerja yang tidak dijangka
e: Special case: accident, work essential to life of community or security of Malaysia, urgent work to machinery, unforeseen interruption, dsb.

q: Had 12 jam sehari di bawah Seksyen 60A(7) TIDAK terpakai kepada pekerja yang:
c: Terlibat dalam kerja tidak aktif atau siap sedia (stand-by) yang panjang
e: Sec. 60A(8): 12-hour limit does not apply to employees engaged in work involving long hours of inactive or stand-by employment.

q: Bagi pekerja syif (Seksyen 60C), purata jam kerja dikira bagi tempoh:
c: 3 minggu
e: Shift work: may work more than 8 hrs/day or 45 hrs/week but the average over any period of 3 weeks (or longer as approved by DG) must comply.

q: Bagi pekerja syif, hari rehat ialah tempoh sekurang-kurangnya:
c: 30 jam berterusan
e: Rest day (Sec. 59): one whole day per week; for shift work – at least 30 hours.

q: Kerja melebihi waktu biasa pada hari rehat dibayar sekurang-kurangnya:
c: 2 kali kadar gaji sejam
e: Sec. 60: work done in excess of normal hours on a rest day shall be paid at least two times hourly rate of pay.

q: Pekerja hamil boleh ditamatkan perkhidmatannya hanya atas alasan:
c: Pelanggaran syarat kontrak dengan sengaja, salah laku atau penutupan perniagaan
e: Restrictions on termination during pregnancy: except on grounds of wilful breach (13(2)), misconduct (14(1)), or closure of business.

q: Majikan mesti memaklumkan Jabatan Tenaga Kerja tentang cadangan pemberhentian (retrenchment) dalam tempoh:
c: 30 hari sebelum pelaksanaan
e: Termination and Lay-off Benefits Regulations 1980: notify Department of Labour within 30 days prior to execution.

q: Pekerja TIDAK layak menerima faedah penamatan jika:
c: Dipecat kerana salah laku
w: Majikan memindahkan kilang ke luar negara
e: Not entitled: retirement (if age stipulated), dismissed for misconduct, voluntary resignation (other than s.13(2)/14(3)), contract renewed with continuous service.

q: Untuk mencegah gangguan seksual, majikan dikehendaki:
c: Mempamerkan notis kesedaran dan menyediakan mekanisme siasatan aduan
e: Prohibitions: sexual harassment – exhibit notice to raise awareness and provide mechanism to inquire into complaints; discrimination; forced labour.

q: Akta 446 terpakai kepada majikan dan pembekal penginapan berpusat di:
c: Semenanjung Malaysia
e: Act 446: applies to all employers and centralized accommodation providers who provide housing and accommodation in Peninsular Malaysia.

q: Di bawah Akta 350, kanak-kanak dan orang muda TIDAK boleh melakukan:
c: Kerja berbahaya yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual Keempat
e: Prohibited employment (Sec. 3): employment contrary to FMA 1967, OSHA 1994 or ESA 1990; hazardous work in Fourth Schedule; Fifth Schedule – employment affecting morals.

q: Kanak-kanak di bawah Akta 350 TIDAK boleh bekerja di antara jam:
c: 8 malam hingga 7 pagi
e: Working hours: children cannot work between 8 PM and 7 AM; young persons between 8 PM and 6 AM (with exceptions); children max 6 hrs/day (7 if attending school).
